property_summary: For any admissible filled long order, c must record the position expiration as the fill timestamp plus the order's duration, so positionExpirations[hashOrder(order)] > the fill-time block.timestamp for every duration > 0; the mutant stores the raw timestamp, violating this for any duration > 0.
change_summary: Store block.timestamp (without adding duration) as the position expiration.
